rationale: Recommend no. The held Federal Register text of EO 11256 (30 FR 14137) states in its section 7 that Executive Order 10472 of July 20, 1953 and Executive Order 10937 of May 3, 1961 are hereby revoked, with no deferred effect or savings wording; the OFR catalog notes agree. The order has no sunset, and no earlier end, partial scope or surviving command was found, so it was not in force on 2026-10-14.
